native_language_semantic_policy: R native scientific artists retain exact Matplotlib source plotting arrays, legend values, scientific text and source image extents, but they are neither Matplotlib Figure/Axes nor pixel-identical Python backend colors. The accepted source-scientific domain is bounded and explicit; all other Python axes/backends remain unresolved outside this scope.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 public src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_sparse_fpca_component. Real fitted univariate sparse PACE mean plus or minus eigenvalue-scaled component mode with exact Matplotlib line ordering, labels and scientific curve coordinates.

Native real sparse FPCA covariance/PACE result, zero-based retained component integer and finite positive SD multiplier. Source default component zero and multiplier two are supported. Arbitrary Python Axes injection, out-of-range indices or fdapace substituted estimators are deliberately refused in strict mode.

The source line arrays are mean, mean-SD×sqrt(eigenvalue)*eigenfunction, mean+SD×sqrt(eigenvalue)*eigenfunction on the actual fitted evaluation grid, retaining the source order and string labels. Committed direct Python 1.2 public plot line get_xdata/get_ydata, titles and labels comparisons use the real native PACE population estimates rather than synthetic fit impersonation. CI runs queued/not observed green.

Reject nonnative fit, nonlogical strict flag, nonnumeric/negative/nonfinite mode multiplier, invalid zero-based component or malformed curve shape. Python TypeError/IndexError class and external axes mutation semantics are not matched.

Three source ordered Matplotlib line data artists with labels fitted mean/-N SD/+N SD and source scientific x/y/title axes are represented by a one-panel native R scientific record. Legacy default returns a four-column numerical data frame. Source Matplotlib Axes runtime identity and pixels remain unavailable.

Population mean and eigenfunction principal perturbations under actual fitted sparse conditional-expectation FPCA covariance, honoring amplitude sqrt(lambda_k) and original source times, not a different score fit.
